Security and moderation review

Use the security feature contract, authenticated API contracts and ledger invariants as one review checklist.

On this page
Threat modelDefense checklistPrivacy and account recovery

Threat model

Threats include forged account/character IDs, client-supplied prices/rolls, replayed commands/tickets, stale zone epochs, negative/overflow quantities, duplicated item locations, bot/rate abuse, teleport/speed manipulation, chat harassment, secret leakage and operator misuse. A dedicated server is necessary here but not sufficient protection.

Defense checklist

  1. Validate authentication/provider nonce/issuer/audience/expiry and bind tickets to identity/destination/version.
  2. Reject unauthorized ownership, stale epoch/revision, untrusted catalog data and invalid integer bounds.
  3. Use parameterized SQL and database uniqueness/foreign-key/check constraints; enforce transaction isolation/lock order.
  4. Keep secrets out of client assets, URLs/logs, documentation examples and screenshots; rotate compromised credentials.
  5. Rate-limit bounded requests and inspect movement corrections/approved modes before automated anti-cheat sanctions under lag.
  6. Filter/rate-limit chat, enforce block lists on every relevant delivery path, provide report/review/escalation and operator audit trails.
  7. Test backup/restore, patch mismatch and replay after crash, not just the normal happy path.

Privacy and account recovery

Publish actual collection/retention/deletion/support policies appropriate to the deployment and account provider. This manual is not legal advice or compliance certification. Use minimal data, access control, protected moderation evidence and a reviewed recovery flow; never expose raw credentials or private chat to public telemetry.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
